audit.whatIsWrong: The level chart gives Urgot Levels 2 through First item, but the packet chart, the 58.33% win rate and every 'whys' line say Nautilus owns those stages.
audit.why: Urgot has no dash until Disdain (E, 16/15.5/15/14.5/14s) and cannot escape a landed Dredge Line; Nautilus is favoured from 2 until Urgot's percent-HP DPS scales.
audit.corrected: Level 1 Skill, Levels 2 through First item Nautilus, 2+ items Urgot.

audit.why: Spikes read levels 2-3 (full pattern), 6 (Depth Charge), first item, and Urgot's 2-item scaling — all four match the kits.

audit.whatIsWrong: Prose leans on 'his W shred' and 'his flip' without naming Purge or giving Disdain's real cooldown.
audit.why: Disdain is 16s at rank 1 and is his only escape from a landed Dredge Line; Purge (W) is a self-slowing channel, so it is punished by walking out, not out-DPSed.
audit.corrected: Name Purge and Disdain, and key the engage to Disdain's 16s.

edits.before: His W shreds your HP — Q-peel his flip, chain CC. Nautilus wins the Disdain cooldown windows.
edits.after: Purge shreds percent HP — keep trades short and hook him while Disdain (16s) is down.

edits.before: Peel his flip and chain CC. Track Disdain before every commit and keep the wave on your side.
edits.after: Bait Disdain, then chain Dredge Line into your passive root — 16s with no dash, he cannot leave.

edits.before: His engage. Q-peel after it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: His only escape, 16s at rank 1. Engage the moment he spends it on the wave.

edits.before: That is Urgot's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: Purge slows him and burns percent HP — step out of its 490 range and it does nothing.

notes: Level chart was inverted against both the packet chart and its own whys text; flipped as an atomic paired group. Urgot's Disdain cooldown (16s rank 1) added where the advice needed a number.
